action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 16, 'col': 32}])

    if c not in colors:
        colors[c] = 0
    colors[c] += 1

    rows = [p[0] for p in b]

    for n in g_nodes:

        rows = [p[0] for p in b]

        print(f"  g at rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")
